verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְדִידָ֥ה בַת־ עֲדָ֖יָה מִבָּצְקַֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·mō·neh šā·nāh yō·šî·yā·hū ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·lō·šîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw yə·ḏî·ḏāh ḇaṯ- ‘ă·ḏā·yāh mib·bā·ṣə·qaṯ
verses.literal: Josiah was eight years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one . . . years His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah she was from Bozkath
verses.literalPt: Josias tinha oito anos quando começou a reinar e reinou trinta e um anos em Jerusalém. Sua mãe chamava-se Jedida, filha de Adaías, de Bozcate.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּכָל־ דֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔יו וְלֹא־ סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·yê·leḵ bə·ḵāl de·reḵ dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw wə·lō- sār yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in all the ways of his father David he did not turn aside to the right or to the left
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová, andou em todo o caminho de seu pai Davi e não se desviou nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ שָׁלַ֣ח הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־ שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן־ אֲצַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ מְשֻׁלָּם֙ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lam·me·leḵ yō·šî·yā·hū šā·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- šā·p̄ān ben- ’ă·ṣal·yā·hū ḇen- mə·šul·lām has·sō·p̄êr bêṯ Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now in the eighteenth . . . year of his reign King Josiah sent the scribe Shaphan son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam to the house of the LORD saying
verses.literalPt: No ano décimo oitavo do rei Josias, enviou o rei o secretário Safã, filho de Azalias, filho de Mesulão, à Casa de Jeová, dizendo-lhe:

verses.original: עֲלֵ֗ה אֶל־ חִלְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וְיַתֵּ֣ם אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְפ֛וּ שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסַּ֖ף מֵאֵ֥ת הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lêh ’el- ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·yat·têm ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·mū·ḇā bêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer ’ā·sə·p̄ū šō·mə·rê has·sap̄ mê·’êṯ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count the money that has been brought into the house of the LORD which the doorkeepers . . . have collected from the people
verses.literalPt: Sobe ao sumo sacerdote Hilquias, para que faça a soma do dinheiro que é trazido para a Casa de Jeová, coletado do povo pelos guardas da porta.

verses.original: וְיִתְּנֹה עַל־ יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּבֵית יְהוָ֑ה וְיִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ לְעֹשֵׂ֤י הַמְּלָאכָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְחַזֵּ֖ק בֶּ֥דֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yit·tə·nōh ‘al- yaḏ ‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ham·mup̄·qā·ḏîm bə·ḇēṯ Yah·weh wə·yit·tə·nū ’ō·ṯōw lə·‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh lə·ḥaz·zêq be·ḏeq hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: And let them deliver it into the hands of the supervisors of those doing the work on the house of the LORD who in turn are to give it to the workmen . . . repairing the damages . . . to the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Que o deem aos mestres de obra da Casa de Jeová e que estes o deem aos que fazem a obra, aos que estão na Casa de Jeová, para repararem os estragos da casa,

verses.original: לֶחָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְלַבֹּנִ֖ים וְלַגֹּֽדְרִ֑ים וְלִקְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְאַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: le·ḥā·rā·šîm wə·lab·bō·nîm wə·lag·gō·ḏə·rîm wə·liq·nō·wṯ ‘ê·ṣîm wə·’aḇ·nê maḥ·ṣêḇ lə·ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: to the carpenters builders and masons to buy timber and dressed stone to repair the temple
verses.literalPt: aos carpinteiros, aos edificadores e aos pedreiros, para comprarem madeiras e pedras de cantaria, a fim de repararem a casa.

verses.original: אַ֚ךְ לֹא־ יֵחָשֵׁ֣ב אִתָּ֔ם הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּתָּ֣ן עַל־ יָדָ֑ם כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō- yê·ḥā·šêḇ ’it·tām hak·ke·sep̄ han·nit·tān ‘al- yā·ḏām kî ḇe·’ĕ·mū·nāh hêm ‘ō·śîm
verses.literal: But they need not account for the money put into their hands since they work with integrity
verses.literalPt: Contudo, não se tomava conta a eles do dinheiro que lhes foi entregue nas mãos, porque eles se haviam com fidelidade.

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֤ן הַגָּדוֹל֙ עַל־ שָׁפָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן חִלְקִיָּ֧ה אֶת־ הַסֵּ֛פֶר אֶל־ שָׁפָ֖ן וַיִּקְרָאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl ‘al- šā·p̄ān has·sō·p̄êr sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh mā·ṣā·ṯî bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yit·tên ḥil·qî·yāh ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er ’el- šā·p̄ān way·yiq·rā·’ê·hū
verses.literal: Then Hilkiah the high . . . priest said to Shaphan the scribe I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD And he gave it to Shaphan who read it
verses.literalPt: O sumo sacerdote Hilquias disse ao secretário Safã: Achei o livro da lei na Casa de Jeová. Hilquias entregou o livro a Safã, que o leu.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֞א שָׁפָ֤ן הַסֹּפֵר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָ֑ר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִתִּ֤יכוּ עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ הַנִּמְצָ֣א בַבַּ֔יִת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֗הוּ עַל־ יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō šā·p̄ān has·sō·p̄êr ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·ḇār way·yō·mer hit·tî·ḵū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ han·nim·ṣā ḇab·ba·yiṯ way·yit·tə·nu·hū ‘al- yaḏ ‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ham·mup̄·qā·ḏîm bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Shaphan the scribe went to the king and reported - . . . . . . Your servants have paid out the money that was found in the temple and have put it into the hands of the workers . . . and supervisors of the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: O secretário Safã veio ter com o rei e deu-lhe conta, dizendo: Teus servos despejaram o dinheiro que se achou na casa e entregaram-no aos mestres de obra da Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסֹּפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖ה הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָאֵ֥הוּ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ šā·p̄ān has·sō·p̄êr lam·me·leḵ lê·mōr sê·p̄er nā·ṯan lî ḥil·qî·yāh hak·kō·hên way·yiq·rā·’ê·hū šā·p̄ān lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Moreover , Shaphan the scribe told the king . . . Hilkiah the priest has given me a book And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king
verses.literalPt: Contou mais o secretário Safã ao rei, dizendo: O sacerdote Hilquias entregou-me um livro. Safã leu-o diante do rei.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י סֵ֣פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־ בְּגָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- diḇ·rê sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw
verses.literal: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law he tore his clothes
verses.literalPt: Tendo o rei ouvido as palavras do livro da lei, rasgou os seus vestidos.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־ חִלְקִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֡ן וְאֶת־ אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁ֠פָן וְאֶת־ עַכְבּ֨וֹר בֶּן־ מִיכָיָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ שָׁפָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ḥil·qî·yāh hak·kō·hên wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·qām be·nō·šā- šā·p̲ān wə·’eṯ- ‘aḵ·bō·wr ben- mî·ḵā·yāh wə·’êṯ šā·p̄ān has·sō·p̄êr wə·’êṯ ‘ă·śā·yāh ‘e·ḇeḏ- ham·me·leḵ lê·mōr
verses.literal: and commanded Hilkiah the priest Ahikam son of Shaphan Achbor son of Micaiah Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah the servant of the king
verses.literalPt: O rei ordenou ao sacerdote Hilquias, e a Aicão, filho de Safã, e a Acbor, filho de Micaías, e ao secretário Safã, e a Asaías, servo do rei, dizendo-lhes:

verses.original: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֣י וּבְעַד־ הָעָ֗ם וּבְעַד֙ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַנִּמְצָ֖א הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־ גְדוֹלָ֞ה חֲמַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִיא֙ נִצְּתָ֣ה בָ֔נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֜וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ עַל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת כְּכָל־ הַכָּת֥וּב עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū ḏir·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ba·‘ă·ḏî ū·ḇə·‘aḏ- hā·‘ām ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘al- diḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er han·nim·ṣā haz·zeh kî- ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh ḥă·maṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer- hî niṣ·ṣə·ṯāh ḇā·nū ‘al ’ă·šer lō- šā·mə·‘ū ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū ‘al- diḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er haz·zeh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵāl- hak·kā·ṯūḇ ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: Go and inquire of the LORD for me for the people and for all Judah concerning the words in this book that has been found For great is the wrath of the LORD that . . . burns against us because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book by doing all that is written about us
verses.literalPt: Ide e consultai a Jeová por mim, e pelo povo, e por todo o Judá acerca das palavras deste livro que se achou; pois grande é o furor de Jeová que se acendeu contra nós, porque nossos pais não deram ouvidos às palavras deste livro, para fazerem conforme tudo o que de nós está escrito.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ֠כֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָ֨ם וְעַכְבּ֜וֹר וְשָׁפָ֣ן וַעֲשָׂיָ֗ה אֶל־ חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת׀ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־ תִּקְוָ֗ה בֶּן־ חַרְחַס֙ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְהִ֛יא יֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַֽיְדַבְּר֖וּ אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên wa·’ă·ḥî·qām wə·‘aḵ·bō·wr wə·šā·p̄ān wa·‘ă·śā·yāh ’el- ḥul·dāh han·nə·ḇî·’āh ’ê·šeṯ šal·lum ben- tiq·wāh ben- ḥar·ḥas šō·mêr hab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm wə·hî yō·še·ḇeṯ bî·rū·šā·lim bam·miš·neh way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·le·hā
verses.literal: So Hilkiah the priest Ahikam Achbor Shaphan and Asaiah went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah the son of Harhas the keeper of the wardrobe She lived in Jerusalem in the Second District
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote Hilquias, e Aicão, e Acbor, e Safã, e Asaías foram ter com a profetisa Hulda, mulher de Salum, filho de Ticva, filho de Harás, encarregado das vestimentas (Ora, ela habitava em Jerusalém no segundo quarteirão.), e falaram-lhe.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’im·rū lā·’îš ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: And Huldah said to them This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Tell the man who sent you
verses.literalPt: Ela lhes respondeu: Assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel: Dizei ao homem que vos enviou a mim:

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ יֹֽשְׁבָ֑יו אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָרָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·‘al- yō·šə·ḇāw ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er ’ă·šer qā·rā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: that this is what the LORD . . . says I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people according to all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Eis que trarei males sobre este lugar e sobre os seus habitantes, a saber, todas as palavras do livro que o rei de Judá leu.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֙עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וְנִצְּתָ֧ה חֲמָתִ֛י בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·qaṭ·ṭə·rū lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·ma·‘an haḵ·‘î·sê·nî bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·hem wə·niṣ·ṣə·ṯāh ḥă·mā·ṯî bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·lō ṯiḵ·beh
verses.literal: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands My wrath will be kindled against this place and will not be quenched
verses.literalPt: Porque me deixaram e queimaram incenso a outros deuses, para me provocarem à ira com todas as obras das suas mãos; portanto, o meu furor se acenderá contra este lugar e não se extinguirá.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְכֶם֙ לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh haš·šō·lê·aḥ ’eṯ·ḵem liḏ·rōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh kōh ṯō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·mā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: But as for the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of the LORD tell him . . . . . . that this is what the LORD the God of Israel says As for the words that you heard
verses.literalPt: Porém ao rei de Judá, que vos enviou a consultar a Jeová, assim lhe direis: Assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel, a respeito das palavras que ouviste:

verses.original: יַ֠עַן רַךְ־ לְבָ֨בְךָ֜ וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע׀ מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽשָׁמְעֲךָ֡ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּרְתִּי֩ עַל־ הַמָּק֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה וְעַל־ יֹשְׁבָ֗יו לִהְי֤וֹת לְשַׁמָּה֙ וְלִקְלָלָ֔ה וַתִּקְרַע֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדֶ֔יךָ וַתִּבְכֶּ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י וְגַ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an raḵ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā wat·tik·kā·na‘ mip·pə·nê Yah·weh bə·šā·mə·‘ă·ḵā ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ‘al- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·‘al- yō·šə·ḇāw lih·yō·wṯ lə·šam·māh wə·liq·lā·lāh wat·tiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏe·ḵā wat·tiḇ·keh lə·p̄ā·nāy wə·ḡam ’ā·nō·ḵî šā·ma‘·tî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its people that they would become a desolation and a curse and because you have torn your clothes and wept before Me . . . I have heard you declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porque se enterneceu o teu coração, e te humilhaste diante de Jeová, ao ouvires o que falei contra este lugar e contra os seus habitantes, a saber, que viriam a ser desolação e maldição, e rasgaste os teus vestidos, e choraste diante de mim, eu também te ouvi, diz Jeová.

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ הִנְנִ֨י אֹֽסִפְךָ֜ עַל־ אֲבֹתֶ֗יךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל־ קִבְרֹתֶיךָ֮ בְּשָׁלוֹם֒ וְלֹא־ תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹל֙ הָֽרָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֖יא עַל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî ’ō·sip̄·ḵā ‘al- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wə·ne·’ĕ·sap̄·tā ’el- qiḇ·rō·ṯe·ḵā bə·šā·lō·wm wə·lō- ṯir·’e·nāh ‘ê·ne·ḵā bə·ḵōl hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ‘al- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh way·yā·šî·ḇū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Therefore I will indeed gather you to your fathers and you will be gathered to your grave in peace Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place So they brought her answer back to the king
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que te recolherei a teus pais, serás recolhido em paz à tua sepultura, e os teus olhos não verão todo o mal que eu trarei sobre este lugar. Tornaram a contar isso ao rei.
